title: IED federation file v1 (<Name>.iedfed)
description: A named set of solutions/folders opened together as one workspace (e.g. this repo with IED + C4, plus a game project). Each member keeps its own .ied/, trust, plugins and settings.

path.description: A .iedsln file or a folder; relative to this file or absolute.

primary.description: Default member for new chats, terminals and the toolbar.

tasks.description: Cross-member tasks (steps may reference member tasks as '<member>:<task>').
